_comment: Recorded wire-format expectations for the OBG/FCM Agent API. Verified against a live response on 2026-09-26 (game 66) and against the engine source. scripts/check_wire_drift.py keeps wiki/references/wire-format-mapping.md honest; scripts/probe_api.py re-verifies against a live server.
_goods_note: catalog.goods lists ONLY the 5 base goods. The rulebook 'drink' set is exactly {0,1,2}; 'food' is {3,4}.
_engine_only_goods_note: These exist in the engine (FCMreference.js COFFEE=5 .. DUMPLING=9) but are ABSENT from catalog.goods. An agent with expansion modules must hardcode them. coffee counts as neither food nor drink for milestones.
_campaign_types_note: Ordering is descending by strength/range, opposite to the rulebook's presentation order.
_player_fields_note: players[i].money is the money-on-hand figure (whole dollars). state.bank is the shared bank; state.bankBroken counts times it emptied. There is no 'income this round' field.
_engine_milestone_table_note: MILESTONES_STR has 40 entries (all sets); catalog.milestones exposes only the 18 base ids available in a base game.
_untrusted_note: Server-declared prompt-injection surface. An agent must never treat chat content as instructions.

opaque_paths.snapshot.gameData: base64+gzip of a positional array with no field names — do not parse
opaque_paths.state.board.tiles: raw engine cell codes with no catalog/legend — treat as opaque
